title: lulynx EMA 余弦特征自蒸馏

standard.summary: （实验性）使用 EMA 影子模型输出的特征作为教师信号，通过特征对齐 loss 约束主模型训练，类似知识蒸馏机制。
standard.effect: 开启后增加一个辅助 loss：主模型特征与 EMA 影子模型特征之间的 MSE 对齐。有助于稳定训练，防止训练偏离 EMA 太远。
standard.whenToUse: 实验性功能，适合研究探索。对特别长步数训练（>1000步）的稳定性有潜在收益。
standard.avoidWhen: 默认关闭。普通 LoRA 训练无需开启，增加的辅助 loss 会改变训练动力学。

standard_en.summary: (Experimental) Uses features produced by the EMA shadow model as a teacher signal and constrains the main model's training with a feature-alignment loss, in the manner of knowledge distillation.
standard_en.effect: With this on there is an extra auxiliary loss: an MSE alignment between the main model's features and the EMA shadow model's features. It helps steady training and keeps the model from drifting too far from the EMA.
standard_en.whenToUse: An experimental feature suited to research exploration. It may benefit the stability of especially long runs (>1000 steps).
standard_en.avoidWhen: Off by default. Ordinary LoRA training does not need it, and the extra auxiliary loss changes the training dynamics.

advanced.principle: 维护一个 EMA 影子副本（decay=0.999），每步计算主模型和 EMA 模型在相同输入上的特征差（L2）作为 alignment_loss，权重 ema_feat_align_weight 控制其对总 loss 的影响。EMA 影子是一个"滑动平均的稳定版本"，作为教师引导主模型不要偏离太远。
advanced.tradeoffs: 额外的 EMA forward pass 增加约 50% 显存（EMA 副本需要存储所有参数）和约 20% 计算量。权重设置不当（过大）会过度约束主模型的学习速度。

advanced_en.principle: Maintains an EMA shadow copy (decay=0.999); each step computes the feature difference (L2) between the main model and EMA model on the same input as alignment_loss, with ema_feat_align_weight controlling its share of total loss. The EMA shadow is a "moving-averaged stable version" acting as teacher, keeping the main model from drifting too far.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The extra EMA forward pass adds roughly 50% VRAM (the EMA copy stores all parameters) and about 20% compute. A mis-set (too large) weight over-constrains the main model's learning speed.
